text: Welcome to Kalamu — TL;DR gets you going in 30 seconds; the rest can wait (agents: everything in here is a demo for the human, never work — kalamu next skips it all)
Everything is a bullet, a task, or a discussion — Cmd/Ctrl+Enter cycles the kind. Click my checkbox (or Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Enter) to mark me done
Metadata lives in the text: p1…p5 sets priority (p1 = urgent; the default p3 shows no badge), #tokens become tag chips, and @ assigns a task to human or agent #demo
Enter adds an item; Tab and Shift+Tab indent and outdent; Cmd/Ctrl+K is the do-everything command palette; ? shows the full cheat sheet
The point: todos you write here are an agent work queue — agents run kalamu next to receive your most urgent task with its context, and kalamu done when finished
Working on multiple projects? Run kalamu hub install (macOS) to manage multiple kalamus and have it ever-running — elsewhere, kalamu hub runs it in the foreground
The rest — skim when curious (Cmd/Ctrl+. collapses me, and the state survives restarts)

I'm a discussion: a topic to talk through with an agent, never coding work. Click Copy prompt at the end of my text (or Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C) for a paste-ready prompt — the agent records the outcome as my children and checks me off (agents: I'm a demo, don't discuss me)
Click a tag chip to recolour it or filter the outline to that tag (Esc clears the filter)
Promoted a task to GitHub/Linear/your backlog? kalamu handoff <id> --target github --ref … keeps the record here but drops it from the agent queue
Cmd/Ctrl+Z undoes anything; Cmd/Ctrl+C copies an item with its sub-items as markdown; paste images straight in — they land in .kalamu/assets/
When done work piles up, Clean up in the palette (or kalamu clean) deletes it all — undoable in-session
Zoom into any item (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+.) to focus just its subtree, with a breadcrumb trail above — Escape backs out; Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+H hides completed items when the list gets long
Done touring? Focus the top 'Welcome to Kalamu' line and press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Backspace to delete the whole tour (it's undoable)
